From 495dd8faf034fe5e2291fc1057ecddfd9a5ba5d4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Seongmin Lee <user@example.invalid>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 22:21:23 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] knot-atproto,knot-xrpc,lexicons: accept user-provided did:plc identities
Change-Id: utnmyryrpswuzornywymloktsyqxwlwm

Signed-off-by: Seongmin Lee <user@example.invalid>
---
 lexicons/repo/create.json                | 2 +-
 lexicons/repo/reserveKey.json            | 6 +++---
 knot2/crates/knot-atproto/src/lib.rs     | 12 ++++++------
 knot2/crates/knot-atproto/src/resolve.rs | 12 ------------
 knot2/crates/knot-xrpc/src/repos.rs      | 16 ++++------------
 5 files changed, 14 insertions(+), 34 deletions(-)

diff --git a/lexicons/repo/create.json b/lexicons/repo/create.json
index fa10be44b95222d29df4453f3857cf890bc49878..3dd8c0a650d11897df74930bab2a1f8931cc0126 100644
--- a/lexicons/repo/create.json
+++ b/lexicons/repo/create.json
@@ -35,7 +35,7 @@
             "repoDid": {
               "type": "string",
               "format": "did",
-              "description": "Optional user-provided did:web to use as the repo identity instead of minting a did:plc."
+              "description": "Optional user-provided DID to use as the repo identity instead of minting one."
             }
           }
         }
diff --git a/lexicons/repo/reserveKey.json b/lexicons/repo/reserveKey.json
index 26c8c1e72ecc56cf9f1fa0631c25f457a6630c27..ea6d0afd7cd6521fa0c37ed0f0c837aeae571665 100644
--- a/lexicons/repo/reserveKey.json
+++ b/lexicons/repo/reserveKey.json
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
   "defs": {
     "main": {
       "type": "procedure",
-      "description": "Reserve a signing key for a bring-your-own did:web repository identity. The knot seals the key and returns its multibase encoding so the owner can publish it in their did:web document before calling sh.tangled.repo.create.",
+      "description": "Reserve a signing key for a bring-your-own DID repository identity. The knot seals the key and returns its multibase encoding so the owner can publish it in their DID document before calling sh.tangled.repo.create.",
       "input": {
         "encoding": "application/json",
         "schema": {
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
             "repoDid": {
               "type": "string",
               "format": "did",
-              "description": "The did:web identity the repository will use."
+              "description": "The DID this repository will use."
             }
           }
         }
@@ -36,7 +36,7 @@
             },
             "key": {
               "type": "string",
-              "description": "Multibase-encoded public key to publish in the did:web document."
+              "description": "Multibase-encoded public key to publish in the DID document."
             }
           }
         }
diff --git a/knot2/crates/knot-atproto/src/lib.rs b/knot2/crates/knot-atproto/src/lib.rs
index 2b2f1e7bd577ba2f41fc43a3a98e48de566de39e..9e9354bc1dc39ffdd635f56f609f396155bdfaea 100644
--- a/knot2/crates/knot-atproto/src/lib.rs
+++ b/knot2/crates/knot-atproto/src/lib.rs
@@ -840,13 +840,13 @@
         pointer::receipt_from_response(&response.body)
     }
 
-    pub async fn verify_did_web_account_document(
+    pub async fn verify_account_document(
         &self,
         did: &RepoDid,
         expected: &PublicKeyBytes,
         expected_pds: &knot_types::KnotServiceUrl,
     ) -> Result<(), AtprotoError> {
-        let url = resolve::web_document_url_for(did)?;
+        let url = self.document_url(&AccountDid::from(did.clone()))?;
         resolve::guard_fetch_url(&url)?;
         let response = self
             .http
@@ -2438,7 +2438,7 @@
         });
         let atproto = Atproto::new(http, clock(), knot_did(KNOT), plc());
         atproto
-            .verify_did_web_account_document(
+            .verify_account_document(
                 &repo_did("did:web:limpet.olaren.dev"),
                 &PublicKeyBytes::from_bytes(sec1(&signing)),
                 &expected_pds,
@@ -2458,7 +2458,7 @@
…
